en: A monochrome historical view over the German town of Bautzen. In the foreground are densely packed houses with pitched roofs. Behind them rises a wooded hill topped with medieval and Renaissance-style fortifications and towers. A tall church with a slender spire (Petrikirche) dominates the skyline to the left, while a large castle complex (Schloß Ortenburg) occupies the right side of the image. The printed captions identify these landmarks.
